title: isotrema obliquum
intro: Isotrema obliquum, commonly known as the Himalayan pine, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Isotrema obliquum include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular-supporting agent, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Isotrema obliquum contribute to its traditional use in Ayurvedic medicine for treating various health conditions.
